runModes.description: Effective run modes; output always reports both effective values.

reasonPayload.description: Discriminated union of every canonical reason code with its registry parameter schema. Raw consumers reject unknown codes and malformed parameters without the repository validator.

residualItem.description: Residual reuses the typed reason payload and permits only code and parameters.

relativePosixPath.description: Strict normalized repo-relative POSIX path: no leading slash, drive/colon prefix, backslash/UNC, empty/repeated separator, or dot/dotdot segment. Shared by RunView freshness and claim.spike_stale reason changes.

freshnessChangeItem.description: Closed freshness change; only normalized path and canonical state, no hash.

runView.description: Public run view. converged lives only on Allow, never duplicated here.

reasonEntry.description: Block reason: the typed reason payload layered with required next_actions/sections and optional affected/message in a closed shape.

allowConverged.description: Allow with converged=true is schema-compatible only with run.status=converged.

allowNonConverged.description: Allow with converged=false requires a non-converged terminal or active run status.

allowContractResult.description: GetContract success carries static contract data; it carries no run state.

allowArgumentConverged.description: GetArgument Allow with the current argument projection; converged=true requires run.status=converged.

allowArgumentNonConverged.description: GetArgument Allow with the current argument projection; converged=false requires a non-converged status.

contractResultIndex.description: GetContract index result carries the canonical PublicContract digest so on-demand discovery can be correlated with RunView contract identity; the digest is not embedded inside PublicContract itself.

digest.description: Canonical digest of public-contract.json computed by the registry_digest algorithm; exact-equal to RunView contract.digest.

contractResultSection.description: GetContract section result carries the canonical PublicContract digest so on-demand discovery can be correlated with RunView contract identity; the digest is not embedded inside PublicContract itself.

digest.description: Canonical digest of public-contract.json computed by the registry_digest algorithm; exact-equal to RunView contract.digest.

untrustedDelimiters.description: Canonical untrusted-data delimiters; values exactly equal the registry.

argumentView.description: Closed GetArgument projection; no generic argument extension map.

route_stamp.description: First-write-wins route witness sequence; null when routing has not been observed.

investigation_stamp.description: First-write-wins investigation witness sequence; null when investigation has not been observed.

kind.description: D1 claim kind, derived from the graph and never inferred by the validator from available artifacts.

gating.description: Bounded public fact that the claim is in the current committed support scope and therefore participates in audit coverage; derived, never editable state.

artifactItem.description: Ordered canonical provenance artifact union; discriminated by kind. Raw schema enforces closure, discriminator, required/forbidden fields, enums, digests, and path invariants per D2C. Per-kind outcomes and spike_gate enums are derived from the registry vocabularies (artifact_kinds/artifact_outcomes/spike_gates).

researchArtifact.description: Fold-1 research citation; no spike fields.

spikeRequestArtifact.description: Immutable sealed pre-execution spike request; no caller-selected gate/exit/outcome, no active flag, no file result binding, no supersedes.

spikeArtifact.description: Spike result attestation; no source fields or dependent_files duplicate.

fileBinding.description: Closed file result binding; path is a strict normalized repo-relative POSIX path and sha256 is a digest256.

privateAllowPresented.description: QUAL-1 private run-bearing Allow: the public author RunView plus the required private governance presentation. Never emitted on the public wire.

privateBlockPresented.description: QUAL-1 private run-bearing Block plus the required private governance presentation.

privateInertPresented.description: QUAL-1 private run-bearing Inert plus the required private governance presentation.

privateGovernanceResponse.description: QUAL-1 private governance response definition: a run-bearing Allow/Block/Inert must carry the private presentation; the public Block/Inert alternatives are restricted to runless results (a run-bearing unpresented Block/Inert is rejected). Validated only inside application governance ingress; the public response schema forbids a presentation key.

identityObservation.description: Open only for allOf extension; every direct $ref use must set unevaluatedProperties: false.

graphClaimItem.description: Closed author-supplied claim vertex for a graph action; matches core.evaluation.valid_graph. Uniqueness, root membership, acyclicity and reachability stay core-only.

graphEdgeItem.description: Closed author-supplied support edge for a graph action.

graphPayload.description: Closed graph action payload owned by the SSOT and projected into the model-facing tool schema. Defence in depth; core.evaluation.valid_graph remains authoritative.

governancePresentation.description: Private governance dialog body. Never present on any public/author RunView; only application governance attaches it to a private context/decision response.
